name: HMA/RSI/LinReg long-only crypto trend, 4H, paper forward test
source: Ziad Francis, CoinQuant_Vs_Python_HMA_Strategy (defaults), reimplemented in signals.py; matches his prepare_dataset exactly on 2017-2026 BTCUSDT (0 signal mismatches)
execution_model: enter at the close of the signal bar, exit at the close of the exit bar, one position per symbol, 100% notional
benchmark: exposure-matched random longs: same trade count and holding lengths placed at random times in the same forward window (2000 draws)
backtest_evidence: BTC 2017-12..2019-02 96th pct, 2019-02..2026-05 99.8th pct vs random timing; ETH/BNB/SOL mixed (SOL failed pre-2021)

decision_rule.pass: pooled BTC+ETH forward timing percentile >= 95 AND net paper return > random-timing median

no_changes: Parameters, symbols, fees and rules above may not change during the test. Any change starts a new test with a new start date.
no_orders: Paper only. This tool never connects to an exchange account.
